sys_tables.__comment: One row per declared table. The product writes every cell but description from the declarations (system_catalog); a person writes description.

sys_columns.__comment: One row per declared column of a table. key_of names the table when the column is one of its key columns, blank otherwise.

sys_chain_rules.__comment: One row per chain rule the chain runs. kind is the declaration's own word (join · decide · mapper ...).

sys_rule_columns.__comment: One row per (rule, column, role): what a rule is woken by, writes, joins or decides on. from_table / from_column: where a written column's value comes from.

sys_ingestion.__comment: One row per folder files are read from into a table: a table's own folder under the workspace, or an external source.

sys_ledger_sources.__comment: One row per ledger source of each world, and the table it reads.

sys_source_builds.__comment: One row per entity type a ledger source builds.

sys_looks.__comment: One row per place a person dragged on a table that reads in entered order (order: entered): look_table the table, look_axis row · group · item, look_key the first row_id of what was moved, position its place - a text between its neighbours' keys. Every key part is filled: a blank one makes no business key, and every write a new row.

indexes.purpose: a read in entered order finds each place

sys_templates.__comment: One row per page the browser collector reads into target_table (its rows' source_name is the template). Elements are CSS selectors; open_method in_place | new_tab; content_area the opened content, what base content reads under; next_method button | scroll (scroll ends after scroll_end_seconds with no new item); max_items empty = no limit; ready_match <item column>=<content column> - the content is the item's only when the two read the same. A row is an edit of target_table.

sys_template_fields.__comment: One row per column a template fills: element read under base - item (the list item, before it is opened) or content (the opened content); take text | an attribute name; regex its first group, empty = all. A row is an edit of target_table.

sys_collect_runs.__comment: One row per collector run (run_id the extension's): written at its start, its five counts at its end under the same key. Who ran it is the cells' updated_by. A row is an edit of target_table.

sys_collect_misses.__comment: One row per item a run did not write: reason no_key | not_opened | refused, detail its sentence (the server's refusal, the extension's timeout), seq its place in the run, cells what was read from it as JSON. A row is an edit of target_table.
